name: 14_Source_of_Funds_Schedule.pdf
summary: Source-of-funds schedule itemising the purchase funds and recording mixed evidence: partial savings evidence, outstanding donor evidence, and supported estate distribution.

overlayBoxes.title: Source-of-Funds Schedule Records Unresolved Evidence Gaps
overlayBoxes.details: The source-of-funds schedule records that savings evidence is only partial and that the donor source-of-funds documentation has not been obtained. It also states that the schedule is not a final approval of source-of-funds evidence.

overlayBoxes.title: Good Practice: Source-of-Funds Schedule Clearly Records Gaps
overlayBoxes.details: The source-of-funds schedule itemises the savings, gift, and estate distribution streams and clearly records which evidence is supported, partial, or outstanding. That is useful file discipline, even though the unresolved gaps still need action.
